grammar_title: 情态动词(modal verbs)+ would 表过去将来
source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 5 Discovering Useful Structures:情态动词表推测/义务/能力请求意愿 + would 表过去将来或过去习惯(取自 The Million Pound Bank Note)。句子地道、语境让唯一一个情态动词成立(强弱推测看证据)。

points.point: 表推测可能性(must / can't / may / might / could)
points.overview: 对现在或一般情况作推测:证据充分的肯定推测用 must("一定");证据不足的可能推测用 may/might/could("也许");否定推测("不可能")用 can't。强弱看语境给的证据。

points.point: 表义务/建议/必要(should / ought to / must / have to / had better / need)
points.overview: 表应该/最好/必须做某事:建议或本分用 should/ought to;强烈必要或规定用 must/have to;给当下具体劝告用 had better;表必要用 need。

points.point: 表能力/请求/意愿 + would 表过去将来或过去习惯(can/could/will/would)
points.overview: 表能力用 can/could;客气请求用 could/would;表意愿用 will/would;转述"过去的将来"(He said he would…)及"过去反复习惯"(she would sit for hours)用 would。

questions.stem: "Henry has his own boat and once worked for a mining company, so he ____ be completely poor — yet he is."
questions.explanation: 前提给出他有船有工作,推断"不可能完全是穷光蛋"——否定推测用 can't。

questions.stem: "The owner stared at the note. 'This ____ be the million-pound note I read about in the papers last week!'"
questions.explanation: 有报纸为证、惊讶认出,强肯定推测"一定是"——must。

questions.stem: "Nobody answered the door, so the brothers ____ be out for the afternoon."
questions.explanation: 只凭没人应门,证据不足的可能推测"也许出门了"——might。

questions.stem: "He is wearing a worn coat and has no small change, so he ____ be a very rich man," thought the clerk.
questions.explanation: 破外套、没零钱,推断"不可能是富翁"——否定推测 can't。

questions.stem: "The light is still on upstairs, so someone ____ still be working in the office."
questions.explanation: 灯还亮着是有力证据,"一定还有人在"——must。

questions.stem: "I'm not sure where Henry went after the party; he ____ have gone back to his hotel."
questions.explanation: "不确定"表明证据不足,弱推测"也许回酒店了"——may。

questions.stem: "She returned every cent and refused a reward, so she ____ be a truly honest person."
questions.explanation: 拒赏还钱是充分证据,"一定是诚实的人"——must。

questions.stem: "The bag was empty when she opened it, so the money ____ be inside it now."
questions.explanation: 袋子是空的,推断"钱不可能在里面"——can't。

questions.stem: "The owner isn't certain, but the strange customer ____ be that famous American everyone is talking about."
questions.explanation: "不确定"提示弱推测"可能是"——could。

questions.stem: "He hasn't eaten since this morning, so he ____ be very hungry by now."
questions.explanation: 一整天没吃,"现在一定很饿"——强推测 must。

questions.stem: "Perhaps the brothers were joking, or perhaps not; the whole thing ____ still be some kind of trick."
questions.explanation: "perhaps"显示不确定,弱推测"也许仍是个把戏"——might。

questions.stem: "A poor sailor ____ possibly own a million-pound note," the waiter thought when he first saw Henry.
questions.explanation: 侍者认为穷水手"不可能拥有百万钞票"——否定推测 can't。

questions.stem: "His face turned pale and his hands shook, so the news ____ have shocked him deeply."
questions.explanation: 脸白手抖是有力证据,"消息一定深深震惊了他"——must。

questions.stem: "I'm not sure, but Lily ____ become a famous actress one day if she keeps trying."
questions.explanation: "不确定"表明只是可能性,"也许有一天会成名"——may。

questions.stem: "There is mud all over his shoes, so he ____ have walked here through the fields."
questions.explanation: 满鞋是泥的实证,"一定是穿过田野走来的"——must。

questions.stem: "The shop was locked and dark all day, so they ____ have been open this morning."
questions.explanation: 整天锁着又黑,"今早不可能开过门"——can't。

questions.stem: "Who knows? The mysterious gift ____ turn out to be a fortune or just an old joke."
questions.explanation: "谁知道呢"显示不确定,弱推测"也许会是"——might。

questions.stem: "She earns a small wage and lives simply, so she ____ be the wealthy widow you imagine."
questions.explanation: 工资微薄、生活简朴,"不可能是想象中的富婆"——can't。

questions.stem: "The lights, the music and the laughter show the party ____ be in full swing."
questions.explanation: 灯光、音乐、笑声都是证据,"派对一定正热闹"——must。

questions.stem: "I have no idea where he is; he ____ be at the consulate, but I really can't say."
questions.explanation: "完全不知道"显示证据不足,弱推测"也许在领事馆"——may。

questions.stem: "The saying means we ____ not judge the value of something just by its external appearance."
questions.explanation: 讲道理给建议"我们不应当只凭外表评判"——should。

questions.stem: "It is getting late and Henry is tired, so he ____ to be on his way home now."
questions.explanation: 本分/恰当之事用 ought to;"他该上路了"——ought (to)。

questions.stem: "You ____ not open the letter until two o'clock — that is the one strict rule."
questions.explanation: 强制性规定"两点前千万不可拆"——must not。

questions.stem: "Visitors ____ show their passports at the consulate before entering; it is required by law."
questions.explanation: "法律要求"是客观必须,用 have to;"必须出示护照"。

questions.stem: "It's already dark and the streets are unsafe, so you ____ better take a taxi home tonight."
questions.explanation: 对当下情况的具体劝告"今晚最好打车"——had better。

questions.stem: "If you find lost money, you ____ try your best to return it to its owner."
questions.explanation: 道义上的应当"应该尽力归还"——should。

questions.stem: "To enter the upper-class party, every guest ____ wear formal evening clothes; no exceptions."
questions.explanation: "无一例外"表强制规定,"必须穿正装"——must。

questions.stem: "There is no rush; you ____ to think it over carefully before settling in London."
questions.explanation: 给建议"你应当好好考虑"——ought (to)。

questions.stem: "The bank says customers ____ repay the loan within one year; it is a firm condition."
questions.explanation: "firm condition"是硬性规定,"必须一年内还清"——must。

questions.stem: "Your coat is so worn; I think you ____ better buy a new one before the meeting."
questions.explanation: 针对眼前情况的劝告"最好先买件新的"——had better。

questions.stem: "We ____ treat everyone we meet for the first time kindly, no matter how they look."
questions.explanation: 讲道理的建议"我们应当善待每个初识的人"——should。

questions.stem: "Because he is on duty tonight, the guard ____ stay at the gate until midnight."
questions.explanation: 因值班这一客观职责而必须,"不得不待到午夜"——has to。

questions.stem: "You don't ____ to pay right now; you can settle the bill at the end of the month."
questions.explanation: 表"没有必要"用 need;"你不必现在付款"——needn't (don't need to)。

questions.stem: "A play ____ to include all its key elements, or the audience will be confused."
questions.explanation: 说明应有之义"一部剧应当包含全部要素"——ought (to)。

questions.stem: "Before the dress rehearsal, the actors ____ remember all their lines; that is the rule."
questions.explanation: "that is the rule"表硬性要求,"必须记住台词"——must。

questions.stem: "You look pale and feverish; you ____ better see a doctor right away."
questions.explanation: 对当下身体状况的紧急劝告"最好马上看医生"——had better。

questions.stem: "When we help someone in need, we ____ not always expect something in return."
questions.explanation: 道理上的应当"不该总想着回报"——should not。

questions.stem: "All passengers ____ fasten their seat belts during take-off; the airline insists on it."
questions.explanation: 航空公司硬性规定,"必须系好安全带"——must。

questions.stem: "You ____ to save a little money each month so that you are ready for emergencies."
questions.explanation: 理财建议"你应当每月存一点"——ought (to)。

questions.stem: "The storm is coming fast; we ____ better head home before the rain starts."
questions.explanation: 对眼前情况的劝告"最好在下雨前回家"——had better。

questions.stem: "Henry told the clerk that without small change he ____ not pay him until the end of the month."
questions.explanation: 转述"过去的将来":主句过去时,从句表将来用 would。

questions.stem: "When she was young, my grandmother ____ sit by the window for hours, telling us old stories."
questions.explanation: 表过去反复发生的习惯"过去常常一坐就是几小时"——would。

questions.stem: "Excuse me, ____ you please step inside for a moment?" the brother asked the young man politely.
questions.explanation: 客气的请求"您能进来一下吗"——would。

questions.stem: "After years of practice, Henry ____ read the difficult contract without any help at all."
questions.explanation: 表过去具备的能力"能够读懂"——could。

questions.stem: "The brothers promised that they ____ explain everything to Henry at exactly two o'clock."
questions.explanation: 转述过去的将来"会解释"——would。

questions.stem: "____ you mind opening the window? It is rather warm in here," Portia said with a smile.
questions.explanation: Would you mind…? 是客气请求的固定问法。

questions.stem: "As a boy, Henry ____ spend whole afternoons sailing his little boat along the coast."
questions.explanation: 表过去习惯"小时候常常"——would。

questions.stem: "Henry was so weak from hunger that he ____ hardly walk another step."
questions.explanation: 表过去的能力(否定语境)"几乎走不动"——could hardly。

questions.stem: "Jim isn't here; he said earlier that he ____ be on duty at the library this afternoon."
questions.explanation: 转述过去说的将来安排"会值班"——would。

questions.stem: "____ you do me a favour and pass the letter to Mr Adams?" the servant was asked.
questions.explanation: 礼貌请求"能帮我个忙吗"——Could you…?。

questions.stem: "In those days the old tailor ____ work late into the night, sewing by candlelight."
questions.explanation: 表过去反复的习惯"那时常常工作到深夜"——would。

questions.stem: "By the age of six, the boy ____ already write his own name in neat letters."
questions.explanation: 表过去已具备的能力"已经会写"——could。

questions.stem: "The ambassador said that Miss Langham ____ be glad to keep Henry company at the party."
questions.explanation: 转述过去的将来"会很乐意"——would。

questions.stem: "It is rather noisy here. ____ we move to a quieter corner to talk?" he asked kindly.
questions.explanation: 客气建议性请求"我们能换个安静的角落吗"——Could we…?。

questions.stem: "Whenever he had a free evening, Henry ____ wander through the old streets of London."
questions.explanation: 表过去反复习惯"每当……他就常常"——would。

questions.stem: "The room was so dark that Henry ____ not see the brothers' faces clearly."
questions.explanation: 表过去的能力(否定)"看不清"——could not。

questions.stem: "He assured the owner that he ____ come back for the other suits later that week."
questions.explanation: 转述过去的将来承诺"会回来取"——would。

questions.stem: "____ you be so kind as to show Mr Adams out?" the brother said to the servant.
questions.explanation: Would you be so kind as to…? 是极客气的请求。

questions.stem: "Before he lost his money, Henry ____ swim across the bay every single morning."
questions.explanation: 表过去反复的习惯"过去每天早上都游"——would。

questions.stem: "Henry felt sure that, with the letter in his pocket, his luck ____ soon change for the better."
questions.explanation: 转述过去时刻的将来感受"运气很快会好转"——would。
